description: The plot illustrates the performance of two different validating methods, SmoE and SimSMoE, as a function of training steps, measured in thousands (x10^3). The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," is linear and ranges from 0 to 50, with tick labels at every 10,000 steps. The y-axis, labeled "BPC," is also linear and ranges from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick labels at every 0.2. The SmoE method is represented by a black line with star markers, while the SimSMoE method is represented by a purple line with circle markers. Both lines start at a high BPC value of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and show a sharp decline to a BPC value of around 1.2 by 10,000 training steps. After this initial drop, both lines exhibit a relatively flat trend, maintaining a BPC value close to 1.2 for the remainder of the training steps, up to 50,000 steps.
